resolutions.decision: Use one V2 terminal arbitration boundary for victory, defeat and escape; context adapters request an outcome, but only the first successful claim may settle.
Defeat is a terminal outcome handled through the shared claim before defeat-side settlement; no victory rewards or loot are permitted.
Manual and automatic escape converge on the shared escape claim; repeated or stale claims return without settlement.

V2 orders terminal claim first, then outcome-specific settlement exactly once, then downstream domain events, then presentation. Victory settlement may include state finalization, reward and drops; defeat/escape must not execute victory settlement.
A failed/already-terminal claim emits no domain settlement events. Presentation is generated from the single accepted settlement result and adapters must suppress duplicate terminal messages.
Terminal state is absorbing. After acceptance, combat actions are rejected; stale/repeated callbacks may render only a non-settlement stale response.
Share terminal outcome and exactly-once vocabulary, but keep PvE, PvP, boss/story consumers and simulator adapters context-specific. Do not force identical settlement side effects.
